nom: The INKEY List Retinol Eye Cream

avis.texte: gifted by theinkeylist At 39, keeping my eye area moisturized is a must, especially since I naturally have dryness and visible fine lines. I don't have any aesthetic treatments, so skincare is really important to me. After just 4 days with this eye cream, I'm genuinely impressed! My skin looks softer, plumper, and much more refreshed, and I could feel the hydration right from the first application.

Not sure if the tube I got was old, but when I use it, the product is separated. I've tried shaking, squishing, rolling the tube to get it to mix, but each time I use it, clear liquid squirts out before the chunky white serum emerges. I don't have that issue with their caffeine eye cream???

This product didn't work for me. I have sensitive skin and this made my skin burn. This also wasn't the best under my makeup. I noticed my makeup would crease under my eye a lot quicker than with other eye products.

I've tried many,high and low end. This one is absolutely amazing at smoothing wrinkles. Makeup applies so much more beautifully now. I am 51 and don't want to be without it. The price is an absolute steal. So good!!

avis.titre: Gentle, effective retinol that actually works
avis.texte: I've been using The Inkey List Retinol Eye Cream for about two months, and I'm genuinely impressed. My under-eye area looks smoother, more even, and less tired ‚Äî without any irritation, redness, or dryness. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and layers perfectly under moisturizer or makeup. What I really appreciate is how gentle it is. It gives you the long-term benefits of retinol (improved elasticity, fewer fine lines) without that initial ‚Äúretinol burn‚Äù phase. I use it every other night after applying a hyaluronic acid serum, and it's been the perfect combination. If you're looking for a beginner-friendly eye cream that actually delivers visible results, this is an excellent choice, simple, affordable, and effective.
It has already improved the condition of my skin around the eyes.
Love this for the texture and feel of it on my skin and I have definitely see the benefits after only a few weeks of using it.
A good eye cream to have for PM but I haven't seen any big changes in my under eyes

I developed milia under my eye from using a heavy eye cream from este lauder. I did not want to pay so much for removal in a derm office and seen this cream helps after 4 weeks and it does!! My milia is gone! Highly recommend if youre experiencing milia!
Really moisturising and calming for the eye area. No smell. Not sure on how many fine lines it has reduced but it's lovely.
This is ok but has not made any improvements on eye area, It is too I harsh on my sensitive eyes and did cause irritation .
I love this and use it a couple of times a week at the moment. It feels nice on my skin and doesn't pull at the sensitive skin around the eyes.
I use this in the pm around my crows lines and lip lines, I definitely notice a difference and wouldn't miss a night of applying!
i have been using this product for years and very happy with the results
despite having very sensitive skin this has not irritated at all , use it at night and the brightening inthe morning , dark circles are improving.
I have tried heaps of under eye creams gro cheap ones to ridiculously expensive .... This is purse friendly and actually works Huge thanks to yhe Inkey List! .
This really is great for fine lines around your eyes and makes your skin look plumper without making it look puffy.

avis.titre: Value for money eye cream with good results
avis.texte: I use to spend a lot of money on my eye cream using high end brands. But after trying this I will stick with this products as value for money & light weight. I like to dab all around my eye not just under the eye and this is good for sensitive eyes which I have as does not irritate or make your eyes puffy. I also like to use across my brow to condition my brows as my hair is sparse and look to condition my brows also to help promote hair growth
This eye cream is well tolerated and my area remains remarkably line free after using this product . I will continue using it to ensure my eye are is hydrated and smooth.?

avis.titre: Bye bye puffiness and dark circles!
avis.texte: I cans struggle with eye creams as they can make my skin sting. This one has been OK so far but the impact is noticeable - definitely noticing a decrease in puffiness and the dark circles are brightening up

I've been using this for about 18 months after I started to notice some fine lines appearing. I first noticed a difference after about 12 weeks of regular use and there is a very noticeable difference and no new lines. Highly recommend
I haven't had this product long enough to know if it will make a difference. But I love the feel and texture. My sensitive skin is not reacting!
Love this product, perfect for my undereye, doesn't itch my eyes.

I like the hydration under my undereye area, I also haven't developed more wrinkes! The only thing I don't like much is that sometimes the ingredients kind of separate. I can get a liquid and the cream separately, you always have to shake it before using it to mix the ingredients back.

Used for about 4-5 weeks and didn't see a huge improvement in aging around eyes. Did notice puffiness would go down from time to time but hard to tell if it was from product. Seems like it could work well with lots of consistent use. The formula was great and super silky!
After 2 months of owning the eye cream, the texture seems spoiled has started separating water and oils.

I haven't noticed a huge difference in my crows feet since using this, but I am hesitant to use anything harsh around my eye area. It absorbs nicely and I layer it under the peptide moisturizer before bed
It's fine enough, but when comparing vs. Retinol Serum for face, there's a clear difference even innresults.
It seems that there are less fine lines around my eyes, the area looks uplifted. I've been using it for more than a year now and I've had a good experience with it so far!
I use the caffeine eye cream am and this one at pm. I've got very sensitive eyes but it doesn't aggravate them. It's really helping under my eyes would recommend
Sinks in well but in all honesty have not noticed any improvement. Will keep trying.
Use it every night, nice rich texture and don't need to use much. Replaces an alternative retinol eye cream and no new lines so must be continuing to do the job!

avis.titre: Good, but too strong for every night on sensitive skin
avis.texte: I can only use this 3 or 4 times a week or it dries my under eyes; but I do have dry, sensitive skin- so imagine fine for nightly use for much. And it's keeping my 40+ year old eyes looking youthful even without using every night.
The texture is eich ans at the same time not to greasqy which is nice. I feel that after 2 weeks the fine lines are less visible around my eyes.
Been using this, not noticed a lot of difference yet, but nice product and will continue with it.
This retinol eye cream is a good targeting eye cream. I use in with the caffiene eye cream and it goes on smooth with no residual feel.
Since using I've felt my eyes seem so much brighter. No more dark heavy eyes
Sinks in beautifully but I haven't noticed a lot of difference
A great eye cream. Easily absorbed, not greasy and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. Only recently started using so not sure if it will deliver results, but I'm happy with what I've seen so far!
I've been using it daily for 3 weeks together with the retinol cream but I don't see any real results yet.

avis.titre: Sinks straight in, not greasy, can see it works.
avis.texte: Love this, my go to eye cream. Sometimes use in the am aswell as pm. Not greasy, sinks straight into the skin. I'm a fan, love it

Retinol Eye cream is my to-go eye cream for the night! I love the texture and I really love how well it goes with my skin! I highly recomend it, i feel it is sensitive skin friendly and the results are visible!
This is a very nice cream, it feels great on the skin, leaves my undereye plump, fresh and hydrated. It is not irritating at all. I use it every single day as a part of my night time routine.
This eye cream isn't harsh and didn't make my skin red or flaky like other retinol eye creams I have tried
I've been using this one for a few months skin around eyes became more moisturised and it helped to reduced under eyes circles. Would recommend
Perfect. It doesn't leave your skin greasy like other Retinols do

avis.titre: Worst eye cream I have ever bought!
avis.texte: I have bought 2 as I have 2 different places I stay. They both separated, leaving you with a watery mess. This somewhat improves after shaking vigorously.
It feels lovely when putting it on, not seen huge results that I've noticed but I think the bags under my eyes are slightly less prominent.

avis.titre: My favorite eye cream against wrinkles
avis.texte: This eye cream has become a part of my skin routine. I love how rich in texture it is and how nicely it helps with wrinkles. If you already have some wrinkles, this won't help you to completely get rid of them. But it very nicely prevents creation of new ones.

I really enjoyed this eye cream. It has a nice consistency, not too thick or too light. I use this more as a preventive measure in my early 30s and I find it helps with darkness under my eyes as well.

I've always just used moisturizer that I've dabbed under my eyes. This eye cream is a medium consistency - rich but easy to put on and soaks in really well. Didn't think I needed eye cream but it has made a noticeable difference with giving my skin a dewy look that people have commented on.
I started by using it 2-3 times a week, now I apply it almost every night. It is my first retinol cream that I can use without side-effects.
This eye cream has helped with the dryness around my eyes, and I really like the texture of the cream. If you could maybe consider putting this in a jar versus a tube, I would love that.
Use on under eye bags and they have shrunk. Very effective. Highly recommend!

So far I have been very pleased. I've had no negative reaction and occasionally products with retinol have given me one. I'm hopeful this will be a product purchase again! I'll give it a bit more time.
the retinol eye cream is a miracle, specially if combined with the caffeine eye cream in the morning!

I have lots of Inky List products which are lovely. This however has a really funky consistency which is not dissimilar to baby sick / curdled milk. It is watery with lumps in. Even when I shake the tube it sounds wet and nothing like an eye cream should be. Not sure if maybe I just have a bad batch?
Haven't noticed much of a difference and is a weird consistency, not sure if I got a bad tube

I love love the inkey list retinol eye cream. It is so effective in getting rid of under eye dark circles. Second time buying it. First time I was discouraged because when I was using it it was watery, but then I realised that it was because of the cold weather that the water separated from the cream. I squeezed the water out and used the cream and after a week, the dark patches had gone. I can't do without it now. Thanks Inkey list for another brilliant product!

The eye cream separates and dermatologist alway say bad formulas separate. I shake the eye cream for 20-30 seconds and it comes out clear still then with bits of white cream. Wouldn't recommend At all. The boots home brand retinal eye cream is half price and better . Was very disappointed.
I've fallen in love with this product as part of my evening skin regime and I wouldn't go without it now. You only have to use a very small amount too so it'll last ages!
Haven't been using long and retinol takes a while to show results

Comfortable to use in the sensitive eye area. Feels well moisturises although I'm not convinced it has made a great improvement to my lines (i.e. looks better when applied but when not on the skin the lines look as they had before I started using).

I use this underneath my eyes every single night for the past 2 months. I wish I had taken a before picture of my under eyes so I could take an after picture and show you guys the difference but WOW is all I can say!!!!

avis.titre: The Only Eye Cream I Need
avis.texte: This eye cream is one of those finds that I now know I can't live without!
This is a nice eye cream, but haven't seen the biggest change just yet. I have waited to the caffeine eye cream and it's lovely
I've followed all the steps and had no reaction to this. It's great!
I have been using this cream for three weeks now. I can see that my eye bags became slightly lighter, but the most important thing is that it doesn't iritetes my sensitive skin around the eyes.
Love this coupled with other products I see a huge difference in my skin I have a scar under my eye I even see that the appearance of that has improved
I use it at night. Helps keep eye area hydrated and helps keep my under eyes smooth.
The product was all separated shaking it to try and mix it back together didn't work. Very disappointed as its usually fine.
I have been using this and am seeing results! Best of all it does promote Milla. I struggle to find creams that don't irritate my under eyes and this product is gentle and effective!
I have been using for a few months and have noticed reduced darkness under eyes as well as smoother skin. Make sure skin is dry before applying.
I have been using this eye cream for over than 6 months and I can honestly say that it has helped with the fine lines around my eyes. I highly recommend it!

avis.titre: I like it! Don't use it too often because it's too strong
avis.texte: I used to use it 3 times per week, but got down to 1 per week because it became too strong.

avis.titre: Do not bother, unless you want your eyes burnt
avis.texte: I used it for 2 days before it completely burned my under eyes. Tried again after a while, same. I couldn't wear makeup for weeks after this. I don't have sensitive skin and never had this issue before. I threw it away and bought the Clinique one for eye wrinkles and it works great.

Left under eye itchy, sore and swollen. Wouldn't recommend, threw away after a couple of uses. around 2-3 weeks after i've stopped using this my under eye is still the same, dry, painful and swollen. Also wouldn't recommend putting this on before concealer as it separates it.

Used it for a couple of weeks, later noticed that the area around my eyes started to look dryer which gave me a tired look. After that noticed that the area around my left started to have creases and it looks like it's giving me wrinkles. Obviously stopped using the product, a bit disappointed with money wasted and a full product I don't know what to do with it.

avis.titre: No irritation but no difference either
avis.texte: I haven't noticed any difference yet using this eye cream, but I also haven't noticed any irritation which is just as important.

I really like the inkey products and was excited to try this. First time using it it stung a little bit. Continued to use it for the next few days but the burning got worse and I had red patches around my eyes. Have stopped using it now & my eyes are better. Real shame.

avis.titre: The only bags I have are Chanel!
avis.texte: Love this especially when coupled with my retinol serum. I feel like it's made a huge difference to the skin around my eyes
Makes eyes feel hydrated and can see visible reduction in crows feet lines !! Just ordered some more !
i haven't noticed a difference but it's hydrating make sure to use at night and use sun cream in the day
Great product noticeably improved under eye bags and puffiness
I use it in the evening. Reduced some fine wrinkles I have, like it

avis.titre: Got rid of my bags / creases under eyes and added bonus on m
avis.texte: I had bags/ lines under eyes and tried many different under eye creams this is the only one that worked - I also use around the lips and has improved lines there too! Would not be without this in my routine now

I use this every evening as part of my pm routine. I like to use it on my fine lines around the eye and mouth area. I feel that it has made a difference however had ro stop using the retinol serum recently as my skin has become allergic to it after using it for over 8 months so I hope I don't become allergic to this too. Texture is good and no scent so perfect for me.

Unfortunately when this arrived it had separated into a watery clear liquid and thick paste, meaning it was unusable. Emailed inkey via their ask@inkey address but no reply. So yeah... Poor product and poor customer service. Not what I had expected from inkey previously
I really like this. It's lightweight and sinks into skin nicely and quickly but thick enough that you only need a tiny amount. I've had mine a couple of months and still going.

Not effective, no noticeable results. Will be switching back to my former eye cream. Not sure how much active ingredient is actually in this. Wish I could get a refund on my order. Did a whole product line and the products haven't done anything advertised.
